credentialFields.label: OAuth client id
credentialFields.help: The client id of a Longbridge OAuth client registered with this deployment's callback URL. Register one once with POST https://openapi.longbridge.com/oauth2/register; docs/connectors/longbridge.md has the exact request.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client secret
credentialFields.help: Only for a confidential client. Registration normally returns a public client with no secret, which signs in with PKCE instead — leave this blank.

credentialFields.label: Environment
credentialFields.help: real for the live account (the default), paper for Longbridge paper trading on the same login.

sandbox.notes: Longbridge paper trading uses the same endpoints, selected per request: link with environment 'paper'. The Paper connector (id 'paper') implements the same contract without a Longbridge account.

compliance.notes: OpenAPI trading and quote access must be enabled on the Longbridge account first, and OpenAPI quote permissions are separate from the app's: Hong Kong real-time quotes and pushes need the LV1 OpenAPI quote card, and Singapore quotes are not served over the API at all.
